title: Ordinary normalization for supported coefficient transport
statement: For prime l, a scheme Y, a projection f from the diagonal surface, a normalized supported source a, completed realizations eP and eW, an ordinary completed coefficient square s, and a coefficient isomorphism i whose underlying map has the prescribed diagonal coefficient normalization, the composite eP.unitIso.symm followed by eP.F.mapIso a.iso, the ordinary square at the completed source, and the direct image of i satisfies SupportNormalization for the condensed supported source.

source.place: paragraph (1); initial coefficient and supported-source identification, expanded in lem-diagonal-completed-frame proof

proof.text: Identify the underlying completed supported source with the additive direct image along the diagonal, and the underlying completed pushforward with additive direct image along f; both object equalities are reflexive. Naturality of eP.underlying expresses the forgotten realized inverse source comparison followed by the coefficient unit map as t.hom followed by the forgotten completed inverse comparison and the unit endpoint map p.

Apply the ordinary square normalization, the input supported-source normalization, and the prescribed coefficient isomorphism normalization. After substituting the two underlying-object equalities, these are ordinary equalities in the additive sheaf categories. The private categorical calculation cancels the ordinary square isomorphism, moves p through the natural composition/congruence/identity comparison, and cancels the coefficient source isomorphism with its inverse. This gives exactly SupportNormalization for the composite ordinary isomorphism. A proved congruence in the bundled category parameter identifies the AddCommGrpCat and Ab presentations of this comparison before evaluation, avoiding reduction of the large direct-image construction.

theorem completedSupportedCoefficient_transport_normalization
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (Y : Scheme.{u})
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (ProjectiveLine Y)]
    [DiagonalTraceLocalizations l (diagonalSurface Y)]
    (f : diagonalSurface Y ⟶ ProjectiveLine Y)
    (R : DiagonalRightDerived (diagonalTracePush l f))
    (a : DiagonalTrace.SupportedSource l Y f R)
    (eP : CompletedRealization l (ProjectiveLine Y))
    (eW : CompletedRealization l (diagonalSurface Y))
    (s : CompletedOrdinarySquare l f eW eP)
    (i : eW.F.obj (diagonalCompletedSource l Y) ≅
      source (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} ℤ_[l]) Y)
    (hi : HEq (eW.underlying.inv.app (diagonalCompletedSource l Y) ≫ i.hom.hom)
      ((lowerStar Ab.{u + 1} (diagonalImmersion Y)).map
        (eP.underlying.inv.app (SheafOfModules.unit
          (Scheme.purTwistRing (ProjectiveLine Y)
            (Scheme.purTwistZlCompletion (ProjectiveLine Y) l))) ≫
          eP.unitIso.hom.hom))) :
    SupportNormalization (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} ℤ_[l]) Y f
      (eP.unitIso.symm ≪≫ (eP.F.mapIso a.iso) ≪≫
        (s.ordinary.app (diagonalCompletedSource l Y)) ≪≫
        ((CondensedRing.lowerStar
          (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj.{u} ℤ_[l]) f).mapIso i)) a.over_eq
